name: Brother Sarno
summary: At the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City, Brother Sarno welcomes visitors and worshipers. He also sends Alliance travelers to Ironforge, where Tinkmaster Overspark needs help reclaiming Gnomeregan.

sections.title: A Welcoming Voice in the Cathedral
sections.body: At the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind, Brother Sarno greets pilgrims and travelers at the entrance. A brother of the Church of the Holy Light, he welcomes those seeking prayer, comfort, or guidance. His kind manner puts visitors at ease amid the cathedral’s daily life.

sections.title: Ties to Ironforge
sections.body: Brother Sarno also helps the Alliance beyond the cathedral. When word reached him that Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge needed help with his rogue invention, Techbot, in Gnomeregan, Sarno directed capable travelers toward Dun Morogh. His aid supports gnomes displaced from their home.

faq.q: Where can I find Brother Sarno?
faq.answer: Brother Sarno stands just inside the main entrance to the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City, to the left of the doors.
Brother Sarno welcomes visitors and worshipers at the Cathedral of Light. He also directs travelers to Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge to help with problems in Gnomeregan.

faq.q: Why does a Stormwind priest send people to Gnomeregan?
aliases: why does sarno care about gnomes
faq.answer: Word reached the clergy that Tinkmaster Overspark needed help reclaiming rogue technology such as Techbot. Brother Sarno directed capable champions toward Ironforge to assist.

faq.q: Does he belong to any specific order?
faq.answer: Brother Sarno is an ordained member of the Church of the Holy Light. He serves beneath the cathedral’s prelates and Archbishop Benedictus in Stormwind.

angles.text: As a priest, you can see Brother Sarno welcoming visitors in Stormwind. He shows the hospitality and gentle grace of the Holy Light.
Though Brother Sarno serves in a human house of worship, he directs willing travelers toward Ironforge to help Gnomeregan recover.
